reviews.comment:
Es parada casi obligada previo a cruzar a Brasil o al ingresar del pais vecino. Lamentable la falta de higiene en los baños.  Tampoco tienen opciones de comida. Y ni hablar lo que demoran para cargarte combustible. Solo tienen 2 empleados y esta llena todo el tiempo. Lo positivo es que están los Sres. Que te cambian dinero de Pesos a Reales o a la inversa.

(Translated by Google)
It's practically a mandatory stop before crossing into Brazil or entering from the neighboring country. The lack of hygiene in the restrooms is deplorable. They also have no food options. And don't even get me started on the wait for fuel. They only have two employees and it's always packed. The positive thing is that there are people who exchange money from Pesos to Reais or vice versa.

reviews.comment:
Muy pocos playeros que son super lentos, y los baños no están tan limpios como otras YPF, la verdad que se entiende por el movimiento que estén cansados los muchachos  pero los propietarios o administradores deben primar el bienestar de los viajantes ya que en temporada alta osea de verano eso es un hervidero y no podes tardar una hs y media para cargar un tanque de combustible.

(Translated by Google)
There are very few attendants, they are extremely slow, and the bathrooms are not as clean as other YPF stations. It's understandable that the staff are tired given the volume of traffic, but the owners or managers should prioritize the well-being of travelers, since in peak season (summer) it's incredibly busy and you can't expect to spend an hour and a half filling up a tank of fuel.
